operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is a Correctness defect within code, while retaining each observed final RQ1 target branch.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_COR after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include incorrect, non-executable, incomplete, obsolete, or otherwise functionally defective code examples.
exclude_rule: Exclude missing task/API coverage (F10), low-value paired supervision (F07), and code Robustness defects (F12).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from Security defects within code to downstream non-Compliance generated-code quality problems.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_SEC unless the final target is RQ1_COM; Security-to-Compliance paths are routed to F03.
include_rule: Include vulnerable, exploitable, or otherwise insecure code patterns with a final non-Compliance RQ1 endpoint.
exclude_rule: Exclude sensitive-content disclosure or another Compliance endpoint (F03), and missing security coverage (F10).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded governance, privacy, licensing, harmful-content, and sensitive-content relations whose final generated outcome is Compliance.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_COM or RQ2_NC_CSR; also assign RQ2_CA_SEC when rq1_target_id is RQ1_COM. Apply these rules before the remaining RQ2_CA_SEC rule for F02.
include_rule: Include Code Compliance, textual Compliance/Security Risk, and Code Security sources when the final target is Compliance.
exclude_rule: Exclude exploitable code weaknesses with a Security target (F02) and corpus-governance concerns without a generated Compliance outcome.

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is a Maintainability defect within code.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_MAI after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include structural, modularity, extensibility, reuse, and maintenance-oriented code defects.
exclude_rule: Exclude clarity-only defects (F05), bundled filters without a unique Maintainability source, and code Robustness defects (F12).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is an Understandability defect within code.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_UND after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include unclear naming, comments, expressions, or other intrinsic code-comprehension defects.
exclude_rule: Exclude paired text/code mismatch (F07), Maintainability defects (F04), and code Robustness defects (F12).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is an Efficiency defect within code.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_EFF after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include inefficient implementations or algorithms in code examples with a downstream RQ1 quality endpoint.
exclude_rule: Exclude response length, training cost, distribution imbalance (F09), and missing performance coverage (F10).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from noisy, erroneous, low-information, irrelevant, malformed, or misaligned non-code supervision.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_NC_LOW after more specific non-code corpus leaves have been ruled out.
include_rule: Include defects in text, metadata, pairing, labels, instructions, comments, or missing context when Low-Value Data is the final source leaf.
exclude_rule: Exclude intrinsic code defects (F01--F06), redundancy (F08), imbalance (F09), inadequate coverage (F10), and contamination (F11).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from duplicate, cloned, or highly similar samples within the training corpus.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_NC_RED after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include training-set-internal duplication or repeated patterns with a final RQ1 generated-code outcome.
exclude_rule: Exclude training--evaluation overlap (F11), general low-value supervision (F07), and output repetition without a training-data redundancy basis.

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from relative prevalence, representation, allocation, or distribution mismatch in the training data.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_NC_DIS after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include measured, controlled, or explicitly discussed comparative imbalance linked to a final RQ1 outcome.
exclude_rule: Exclude simple absence or inadequate coverage (F10), data volume alone, and synthetic origin without a measured mixture effect.

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from missing or insufficient task, domain, language, API, temporal, security, performance, or format coverage.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_NC_DIV after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include a coverage gap without the comparative prevalence evidence required for Distribution Imbalance.
exclude_rule: Exclude intrinsic code defects (F01--F06), measured relative imbalance (F09), and training--evaluation overlap (F11).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from verified or explicitly qualified potential overlap between training data and evaluation material.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_NC_CON after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include contamination or qualified familiarity comparisons with an identifiable final RQ1 generated-code deficiency.
exclude_rule: Exclude benchmark inflation without an RQ1 deficiency and duplication confined to the training corpus (F08).

operational_definition: Groups atomically coded relations from fault-tolerance, input-validation, exception-handling, or boundary-checking patterns in training code to generated-code Robustness or task-specific Correctness outcomes.
routing_rule: Assign RQ2_CA_ROB after the final source and target leaves have been fixed.
include_rule: Include an explicitly identified code Robustness property with an identifiable RQ1 endpoint under boundary, exception, or non-malicious error conditions; author discussion and bundled cleaning evidence are allowed when their limitations remain attached to the assignment.
exclude_rule: Exclude generic cross-benchmark stability, adversarial prompt robustness, reward-only interventions, and training-code Correctness, Security, Maintainability, Understandability, or Efficiency defects with a more specific source leaf.
